We are hiring!
Operations Manager — Reefer Dispatch
We’re a fast-growing American logistics company expanding our refrigerated (reefer) operations. We’re seeking a hands-on
Operations Manager (Reefer Dispatch)
to lead a high-performing team, scale processes, and deliver outstanding results for our drivers, brokers, and customers.
What You’ll Do
Lead, coach, and develop a team of reefer dispatchers (hiring, training, performance, schedules).
Own daily operations for a multi-truck reefer fleet: planning, load coverage, routing, and service recovery.
Monitor cold-chain integrity and appointment compliance; minimize delays, layovers, and claims.
Negotiate with brokers/carriers; maximize revenue per truck, reduce empty miles, recover accessorials (detention/TONU/lumper).
Track and improve KPIs:
OTD%
,
RPM
,
revenue per truck/week
,
empty mile %
,
claim rate
,
driver retention
,
customer scorecards
.
Drive cross-team collaboration (Safety, Accounting, Recruiting, Maintenance).
Standardize SOPs, shift handoffs, and TMS/dispatch workflows; escalate issues quickly and decisively.
Handle customer escalations professionally and keep stakeholders informed.
What We Expect
2+ years
in U.S. trucking operations with
reefer dispatch
experience;
1+ year
leading a team.
Strong English communication (Russian/Romanian a plus). Calm under pressure, solution-driven.
Confident with TMS/ELD/dispatch tools and load boards; Excel/Google Sheets basics.
Proven broker negotiation skills and understanding of cold-chain specifics (appointments, lumpers, temp control).
Detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable with the
15:00–00:00
schedule.
What We Offer
Competitive salary
+ performance bonuses
tied to clear KPIs.
Official employment and full social package.
A supportive culture with real decision-making authority.
Paid training, documented SOPs, and continuous growth opportunities.
The chance to scale a modern reefer operation inside a growing company.
Ready to lead and win?

Мы ищем новых людей в нашу команду:
Technical Marketing Specialist / Технический Маркетолог
О компании
Мы — digital-агентство, которое быстро растёт и работает с e-commerce, медицинскими центрами, услугами, строительством и локальными брендами в Молдове, Румынии и СНГ.
Нам нужен технический маркетолог — человек, который станет ключевым звеном в аналитике, технической части проектов и контроле процессов.
Основные обязанности
- Настройка и контроль аналитики: GA4, GTM, Meta Pixel, Conversion API.
- Настройка событий, форм, отслеживание лидов, корректная передача данных.
- Работа с сайтами: Tilda и WordPress (интеграции, структура, скорость загрузки).
- Контроль качества визуалов: проверка баннеров, проверка макетов от дизайнера.
- Техническое сопровождение Meta / Google Ads: структуры, UTM, события, диагностика.
- Подготовка еженедельных отчётов, обновление KPI, ведение Google Sheets и Trello.
- Анализ ошибок, мониторинг показателей, техническая оптимизация.
- Поддержка основателя агентства в операционных маркетинговых задачах.
Требования
- Опыт работы с GA4 и GTM — обязателен.
- Понимание Meta Ads, Pixel и Conversion API.
- Навыки работы с Tilda или WordPress.
- Базовые навыки дизайна (Figma, Canva).
- Системность, внимательность, аккуратность.
- Умение работать без микроменеджмента.
- Умение работать в быстром темпе и быстро вникать в процессы.
Формат работы и условия
- Формат: удалённо.
- Занятость: 3–5 часов в день (как основная или дополнительная занятость).
- Зарплата: 400–700 € в месяц + бонусы от проектов.
- Гибкий график.
- Рост до ведущего технического специалиста агентства.
- Работа с сильной маркетинговой командой и крупными клиентами.

— своё CV
— примеры работ (если есть)
— короткое сообщение о себе в Telegram или Email.

Inginer vânzări instalații
ATENȚIE! Acest post este disponibil în orașul Hîncești!
Pasionat de meseria ta?
La Romstal, lider de piață în domeniul instalațiilor termo-hidro-sanitare, ne dezvoltăm împreună, atât în Moldova cât și în Europa! Cu extindere în 6 tări din Europa, Romstal este compania care tinde să crească standardul de viață al clienților săi prin produsele și serviciile pe care le oferă.
Colegii noștri din Departamentul Vânzări au devenit cei mai buni specialiști în domeniul instalațiilor și te așteaptă alături de ei!
Acest job ți se potrivește dacă:
Ești o persoană care comunică ușor cu ceilalți, se adaptează și poate să convingă usor;
Ai o atitudine pozitivă, ești organizat și poți lucra simultan pe mai multe activități;
Ești o persoana energica, orientata spre rezultate și spre învățare;
Te interesează să lucrezi cu produse și tehnologii noi în domeniul instalațiilor;
Ești preocupat să construiești și să dezvolti relații puternice cu clienții;
Ai valori personale solide de onestitate, integritate și grijă față de mediu;
Ai permis categ B și îți place să ai un job activ, pe teren;
Cunoști limbile română și rusă.
Descrierea jobului
Scopul Jobului:
Vânzarea produselor și echipamentelor din oferta companiei, precum și consilierea tehnică în vederea alegerii soluției optime care să raspundă nevoilor clienților.
Ne dorim ca împreună să oferim clienților cea mai bună experiență de vânzare, propunând soluțiile de instalații potrivite. În acest sens, vei asigura consultanța tehnică clientilor B2B sau clientilor finali și vei realiza ofertele care raspund standardelor tehnice în domeniu și nevoilor clienților. În susținerea activității tale, vei lucra cu instrumente de organizare, raportare si planificare. Te vei dezvolta profesional permanent și vei învața în fiecare zi să fii mai bun în consultanța oferită clienților tăi și să le crești gradul de satisfacție.
La Romstal te-ar putea interesa și următoarele beneficii:
Bonusuri pentru performanță în vânzări;
Beneficii extrasalariale: tichete de masă, evenimente și cadouri pentru copii, evenimente pentru angajați, etc;
Traininguri tehnice și de vânzări;
Muncă într-o companie multinațională, cu standarde de lucru profesioniste;
Posibilități de dezvoltare a carierei.
Suntem orientați spre rezultate și punem preț pe dezvoltarea profesională a oamenilor din companie.
Dacă împărtășești și apreciezi aceleași valori, vino alaturi de noi!

Salesforce Business Analyst
We’re a boutique travel agency that crafts one-of-a-kind premium travel experiences for a select global clientele. Exceptional service is at the core of our brand—and technology is how we deliver it at scale.
We build most of our software in-house, including Salesforce-based platforms that power our Sales, Support, Operations, Experts, and Concierge teams. As we continue to elevate the customer journey, we’re expanding our data & systems team to discover smarter, more automated, and more personalized ways to serve travelers.
The Role
We are looking for a
Mid to Senior Salesforce Business Analyst
who can bridge business needs with technical solutions. You will analyze business processes, design scalable workflows in Salesforce, and partner with Product, Engineering, and Operations to build systems that power a world-class travel experience.
This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoys solving complex operational problems, and wants to have a meaningful impact on internal efficiency and customer satisfaction.
What You’ll Do:
Lead discovery sessions with Sales, Operations, Finance, and Product teams to understand workflows and identify automation opportunities.
Translate business requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, and functional specifications.
Design scalable Salesforce solutions using best practices (Flows, validation rules, case/lead automation, record types, permission models).
Support the development lifecycle by collaborating with Developers to shape configuration vs. customization decisions.
Create and manage documentation for processes, data models, SOPs, and platform governance.
Facilitate and support UAT, coordinating with stakeholders to validate solutions.
Build dashboards and reports to empower departments with actionable insights.
Identify system bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and data-quality issues, and propose process or architectural improvements.
Partner closely with Product Owners to drive Salesforce roadmap initiatives.
Train team members on new features, workflows, and best practices to ensure successful adoption.
What We’re Looking For
3+ years of experience as a Salesforce Business Analyst, System Analyst, or similar role.
Strong understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud (objects, flows, security, automation).
Hands-on experience designing complex end-to-end business processes.
Ability to translate ambiguous requirements into structured, actionable, and scalable solutions.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Experience writing detailed user stories and documentation in Jira/Confluence.
Comfortable running workshops, documenting AS-IS and TO-BE processes, and presenting to cross-functional teams.
Excellent communication skills, capable of aligning business and technical stakeholders.
Familiarity with data modeling, data governance, and reporting best practices.
A proactive mindset,someone who sees problems before others do and proposes thoughtful solutions.
It Would Be a Plus If You Have:
Experience with Digital Engagement (chat, WhatsApp, messaging).
Understanding of API integrations, middleware, or ETL tools.
Experience working in a high-volume support or sales environment (e.g., travel, hospitality, marketplace, contact center).
Knowledge of SQL or data analytics tools (Tableau, Quicksight, Power BI,etc).
Background collaborating with Product teams in agile environments.
Technical Background.
What We Offer:
Competitive salary, aligned with experience and market standards.
Official employment (IT Park).
Access to professional learning resources (Udemy, O'Reilly, and others).

Accounting Settlements Coordinator
We are looking for a Accounting Settlements Coordinator to join our finance & operations team!
If you are detail-oriented, organized, and ready to grow your career in a fast-expanding U.S. logistics company — this role is for you!
About the Role
As a Settlements Coordinator, you play a vital role in ensuring our independent contractors and
drivers are paid accurately and on time. You’ll be the go-to expert for settlement processing,
documentation accuracy, and financial troubleshooting — helping deliver a seamless payment
experience that strengthens our driver relationships and supports our operational success.
In this high-impact position, you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the organization, drive
process improvements, and maintain the consistency and reliability of our settlement workflow.
What We Offer:
Competitive salary
with room for growth
Structured processes and full training
based on our company standards
Work directly with
U.S. drivers, brokers, and internal departments
Friendly, stable, and professional team environment
Gain valuable
international logistics experience
Comfortable office in the center of Chișinău
Official social package + bonus programs
What You’ll Do
Core Responsibilities
Serve as the primary contact for all settlement-related communication, including
monitoring dedicated email inboxes, phone calls, and texts.
Manage reimbursement requests and ensure timely, accurate processing.
Update and maintain payee information in McLeod based on executed DocuSign
documentation.
Set up recurring deductions and one-time charges for new drivers.
Verify that all owner-operator invoices have been posted accurately by Accounts
Payable.
Audit settlements and update notes to ensure precise payout calculations.
Apply first-week deduction adjustments for new drivers.
Download, verify, and post fuel, Love’s, tolls, and IFTA reports.
Review and process referral bonuses.
Maintain and update the Transport Missing Paperwork & Updates report to support prompt billing.
Coordinate with Fleet Managers regarding loads requiring additional documentation.
Reach out to drivers regarding missing BOLs.
Process driver reimbursements with supporting receipts.
Calculate weekly payroll for company drivers (Wednesdays) and LP/OO drivers (Thursdays).
Prepare and distribute the Negative OO Balance report.
Conduct post-settlement follow-ups with new drivers.
Lead the settlements portion of weekly driver orientation via Google Meet.
Key Challenges & Opportunities
Encouraging timely submission of driver paperwork.
Delivering consistent and accurate payroll under tight deadlines.
Implementing and maintaining reporting tools (fuel rebate, IFTA, tolls, etc.).
Streamlining and improving end-to-end settlement processes for greater efficiency.
What Success Looks Like (KPIs)
Accuracy of Settlements – minimal corrections or discrepancies.
Turnaround Time – timely processing of weekly payroll cycles.
Discrepancy Resolution – fast and effective handling of driver questions or issues.
What You Bring
Education
High school diploma or equivalent required.
Associate degree preferred.
Prior experience in the transportation industry is required.
Skills & Qualifications
Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
Fast learner with motivation to grow within the company.
Ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
Strong mathematical and analytical skills.
Proven ability to identify discrepancies and resolve issues quickly.
Excellent communication and organization skills.

Monday to Friday — 15:00 to 00:00 (Moldova time)
(American schedule, perfect for productive evening work.)

Sales Enablement Designer
Join Us at Parkopedia – Now Proudly Part of Arrive
Together, we make cities more livable
We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us!
As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. Our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together. Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travelers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best. For our customers. For the cities and communities we serve. For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let’s grow better, together.
The Role
The Sales Enablement Designer will create impactful sales materials and clear product guides that help our B2B sales teams win deals and accelerate customer adoption. This role focuses on translating complex parking solutions into compelling content across multiple brands, markets, and customer segments. You'll work at the intersection of sales, product, and brand, creating materials that remove friction throughout the sales cycle.
How to make an impact
Design and adapt sales materials (one-pagers, battle cards, competitive sheets, pitch decks) that position our solutions effectively across different customer segments
Create product enablement content (quick-start guides, admin setup instructions, feature overviews) that demonstrate ease of implementation and reduce technical objections
Develop demo scripts, presentation materials, and conversation guides for sales conversations
Document new features in sales-ready formats that translate technical capabilities into customer benefits
Build scalable content templates that work across EasyPark, RingGo, and Parkmobile brands
Collaborate with sales teams to understand objections and create content that addresses real buying friction
Maintain brand consistency while optimizing for sales effectiveness across 10+ markets and languages
About you
You thrive when creating content that serves a clear purpose. You understand that good sales content isn't just pretty; it needs to answer real customer questions and remove real buying friction. You're equally comfortable making something persuasive (a one-pager that opens doors) and making something clear (a setup guide that eliminates technical concerns).
Your background
2-4 years creating B2B sales materials, product documentation, or marketing content
Portfolio demonstrating both persuasive sales content AND instructional product guides
Strong copywriting skills, ability to simplify technical features into customer benefits
Proficiency in design tools (Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Google Suite, or similar)
Understanding of B2B sales processes and what content helps close deals
Experience with localization and multi-market content adaptation
Fluent in English; additional language skills are a plus
Comfortable with structured, repeatable work across multiple products and formats
About us
Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Present in over 90 countries and 20,000 cities, the company helps people and decision-makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide. Arrive delivers a unique combination of the core ingredients to make cities more livable: from smart payments and optimized car parks to data-driven traffic reduction and support for reinvestment in public transport and green space. It’s about more than function, it’s about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it’s how you Arrive.
Benefits
Arrive is committed to creating a great work environment for all our employees. Here are just a few of the benefits we offer:
Unlimited annual leave – we believe time off is as important as time in the office. We all need to unwind and recharge our batteries!
Flexible working hours (within standard business hours, no weekend work).
Hybrid work format: half of the week in the office and the other half potentially working from home.
Training allowance.
Private medical support.
Fresh fruit, tea, and coffee.
Monthly team lunch.
Time off for volunteering.
This role is based in our office in Chisinau, Moldova.
To apply for this job, please visit:

RESOURCE PLANNING SPECIALIST
We are seeking Resource Planning Specialist to support us through the next evolution of our business as we grow. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast growth scale up technology firm and carve out an exciting career path. The successful applicant will be a self-motivated self-starter with an open, vibrant attitude.
WE ARE AMDARIS
We bring together the best talent and next-level ideas to create outstanding solutions. With 40% year on year growth every year under our belt over the past four years, we have big plans for the future. Our growth plan is ambitious, and our projects take software to the next level, so join our team in the centre of Chisinau.
RESOURCE PLANNING SPECIALIST RESPONSIBILITIES
The main purpose of the role is to act as a link between Recruitment, Talent Pool and Delivery as the business rapidly scales and changes. You’ll be crucial as a single point of information and a bridge between resources and projects. Our main goal is to create productive teams and match the existing talent with the existing and future projects.
As a Resource Planning specialist you’ll participate in planning, allocate based on requirements across the group’s development projects and management of the company's resources as efficiently as possible. The role involves collaborating proactively with business leaders, managing demand, and forecasting workforce requirements. Furthermore, you’ll need to consult with the business on permanent workforce needs, participate in creating strategies that balance cost management and quality service delivery.
You will participate in the generation of the Recruitment Demand per group and its Analytics (Forecasting).

Proven experience in Human Resources and Project Management/ Recruitment in the IT field at least 2 years
Strong written and verbal communication skills including technical writing skills
Capable multi-tasker (able to keep track of a large number of projects and team members)
Exceptional organizational and time-management skills

Nanu Market
является лидером продаж на рынке строительных материалов и товаров для дома в Молдове, имея более чем 20-летний опыт. Мы предлагаем широкий ассортимент продукции для розничных и оптовых клиентов, включая электроинструменты и бытовую технику.
Продавец-консультант, Секция сухие смеси: цемент, штукатурки, шпаклёвки.
Требования к кандидатам:
Ответственный и ориентированный на результат человек;
Вежливый, с хорошими коммуникативными навыками;
Со специальным образованием или без него;
Опыт в продажах или в строительстве.
Обязанности:
Оказывать поддержку клиентам в выборе необходимых товаров;
Консультировать клиентов по ассортименту, качеству и ценам на продукцию;
Следить за правильностью выкладки товаров и цен на полках.
Преимущества:
Месторасположение: ул. Конструкторилор 1, сек. Рышкановка;
Фиксированная арплата и другие ежемесячные бонусы % (выполнение плана продаж, продажа определённых категорий товара);
Скидки на все бренды компании и внутренние акции для сотрудников;
Корпоративная столовая на территории;
Обучение и возможность карьерного роста в команде профессионалов.
Место работы:
Constructorilor 1, сектор Рышкановка (Старая почта).

Customer Care Representative
Join Us at Parkopedia – Now Proudly Part of Arrive
Together, we make cities more livable
Our Drive
At Arrive, we love cities. We love them for work, for play, and everything in between. That’s why our mission is to make life in cities that much easier – by taking care of the parking. Using smart technology, we break barriers to improve the urban experience. Our aim is to create a scenario where parking supply and driver demand are balanced — not through more parking spaces or fewer cars, but through predictive technology that connects users with available spots.
At Arrive, it's the people that make the difference. We stay true to our values of playing together, staying curious, and always moving forward — step by step, inch by inch.
The Role
This is a pilot project being launched for the first time in Moldova. It will open up significant opportunities for career development and professional growth within the company.
The role is based on-site at the Arrive office in Chișinău, Moldova.
As a
Customer Care Representative
, you will be the first point of contact for Arrive customers, ensuring a positive, helpful, and empathetic customer experience across multiple channels. You’ll work closely with your team and managers to uphold our customer service standards and contribute to a high-performance support environment.
You will:
Execute the Customer Care strategies set by the Customer Care Management team.
Build and maintain strong, supportive relationships with Arrive customers, primarily in the B2C segment, and occasionally with B2B customers.
Handle incoming contacts via phone, email, social media, and any other channels in use — always leaving the customer with a positive and professional impression.
Log interactions and collect relevant customer insights, following current internal guidelines.
Continuously monitor your own performance against KPIs, and contribute toward meeting or exceeding team goals.
Proactively suggest improvements to customer care processes and escalate insights to team managers or process drivers.
Key Performance Indicators
While Customer Care objectives may evolve over time, some of the KPIs we regularly track include:
Contact Ratio – measured on both market and company levels.
Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) – our core quality metric, measured across individuals, teams, and markets for all channels.
Contacts Per Hour (CPH) – our primary efficiency metric, also measured on individual, team, and market levels.
Who You Are
To thrive in this role, we believe you’ll recognize yourself in the following:
You have strong English language skills at C1 level (advanced).
You are empathetic, helpful, and solution-oriented.
You’re a great communicator with strong listening skills and a calm, patient approach.
You enjoy solving problems and are quick to understand and resolve customer needs.
You’re self-motivated and capable of managing your time effectively, even under pressure.
You’re a team player — collaborative, respectful, and supportive of your colleagues.
You embrace feedback, learning, and change with an open mind.
You see challenges as opportunities to grow, and you’re excited by the chance to make a difference in the daily lives of our users.
Knowledge of Swedish or Norwegian would be a plus, but is not required.
One Final Thing
Arrive expects a lot — not in the old-fashioned way, but in expecting your ideas, energy, and ownership. We seek individuals who are passionate, driven, and ready to help shape the future of urban life. With us, you’ll have the freedom to thrive, the support to grow, and the chance to be part of something meaningful.
Send your CV via the link:
https://careers.arrive.com/jobs/6282356-customer-care-representative

Specialist, Direcția Administrare Riscuri Operaționale și Financiare, Departamentul Administrare Riscuri
Vei fi responsabil de:
Asigurarea identificării, colectării, înregistrării și evaluării datelor interne și externe privind evenimentele de risc operațional;
(inclusiv a fraudelor sau suspiciunilor de fraudă internă sau externă);

Efectuarea analizei incidentelor, inițierea investigațiilor și implementarea măsurilor de diminuare a nivelului de expunere a băncii la riscul operațional;
Identificarea riscurilor şi deficienţelor aferente la implementarea produsului nou, schimbării semnificative sau a modificării produsului existent;
Desfășurarea seminarelor/ webinarelor pentru instruirea angajaților băncii, precum și a noilor angajați în domeniul administrării riscului operațional.
Este necesar să ai:
Studii superioare în domeniul financiar – economic;
Experiență de muncă de minim 1 an în domeniul administrării riscurilor în sectorul financiar;
Cunoașterea fluentă a limbilor română și rusă;
Calificări profesionale și personale: autoperfecționare profesională, abilități analitice, creativitate, inițiativă, integritate, responsabilitate.
Oferim:
Cursuri gratuite de formare și dezvoltare profesională;
Prima de performantă;
Vineri - zi de lucru cu program de muncă redus.

Продавец-консультант | Секция товары для дома
Nanu Market
является лидером продаж на рынке строительных материалов и товаров для дома в Молдове, имея более чем 20-летний опыт. Мы предлагаем широкий ассортимент продукции для розничных и оптовых клиентов, включая электроинструменты и бытовую технику.
Продавец-консультант, Секция товары для дома:
https://nanu.md/casa-si-bucatarie-
Требования к кандидатам:
Ответственный и ориентированный на результат человек;
Вежливый, с хорошими коммуникативными навыками;
Со специальным образованием или без него;
Опыт в продажах или в строительстве.
Обязанности:
Оказывать поддержку клиентам в выборе необходимых товаров;
Консультировать клиентов по ассортименту, качеству и ценам на продукцию;
Следить за правильностью выкладки товаров и цен на полках.
Преимущества:
Месторасположение: ул. Конструкторилор 1, сек. Рышкановка;
Фиксированная арплата и другие ежемесячные бонусы % (выполнение плана продаж, продажа определённых категорий товара);
Скидки на все бренды компании и внутренние акции для сотрудников;
Корпоративная столовая на территории;
Обучение и возможность карьерного роста в команде профессионалов.
Место работы:
Constructorilor 1, сектор Рышкановка (Старая почта).
